title.en: Japanese mortise case and cylinder (MIWA / GOAL style)
title.zh: 日式插芯锁体与锁芯（MIWA / GOAL 类）

summary.en: Japan has its own dominant makers and its own case geometry, with a backset commonly around 64 mm rather than the European 55/60 mm. Replacement parts are matched by maker part number far more often than by a published standard dimension.
summary.zh: 日本有自己主导的厂商与锁体几何，背距常见约 64 mm，而非欧式的 55/60 mm。更换件更多按厂商料号匹配，而不是按公开标准尺寸。

en: Mortise case, often with a maker-specific faceplate
Replaceable cylinder, sometimes a knob-integrated type
Optional electronic unit already fitted on apartment doors
zh: 插芯锁体，面板常为厂商专用
可更换锁芯，部分为旋钮一体式
公寓门上常已装有电子单元

measurements.typical: 64 mm common; 51 and 64 mm appear most often

how.en: Door edge to the cylinder centre.

measurements.typical: Varies by maker; record the actual value
Maker-specific; record width × length rather than assuming a size

how.en: Measure the strip on the door edge and photograph the maker's marking on it.
how.zh: 量门边金属条，并拍下上面的厂商标记。

notes.en: Japanese apartments are the one market where smart locks arrived as a default fitting rather than a retrofit, so the aftermarket is thinner. Record maker part numbers — they are more reliable than dimensions here.
notes.zh: 日本公寓是智能锁作为标配而非改造品进入的市场，因此后装市场较薄。请记录厂商料号——在这里它比尺寸更可靠。

en.q: Can a euro-cylinder smart lock fit a Japanese door?
en.a: Rarely. The backset, the cylinder profile and the case geometry all differ; a euro clamp assumes a 17 × 33 mm profile cylinder.

zh.q: 欧标锁芯的智能锁能装日本门吗？
zh.a: 很少能。背距、锁芯槽型与锁体几何都不同；欧标夹具默认是 17 × 33 mm 槽型锁芯。
